prayerExcerpt.en-US: Thus by his zeal he preserved the integrity of faith, and by his toleration and forbearance saved many souls.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Assim, por seu zelo preservou a integridade da fé, e por sua tolerância e paciência salvou muitas almas.

meta.face: A Roman of about fifty-five, CLEAN-SHAVEN as on the Speyer reliquary head, with a pale olive complexion and a LONG, NARROW face under a PROMINENT, ROUNDED forehead that bulges over the brows — SUNKEN temples, LARGE, DEEP-SET dark eyes in shadowed sockets under thin, straight brows, a LONG, STRAIGHT, NARROW nose running on from the brow line, FLAT cheeks, a SMALL, soft, closed mouth, a SHORT, POINTED chin; close-cropped dark hair touched with grey, cut straight across the forehead; a patient, forbearing look. Not the bald, hook-nosed sixtus_ii, nor the fine-boned, hump-nosed fabian.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The gold reliquary head in Speyer Cathedral shows him beardless with a long, straight nose; the St. Paul Outside the Walls medallion is a later imagined type. The book tells the archdeacon who became pope, the rebaptism controversy and the catacomb Masses; the face is ours, after the Speyer head.
